name: Attribute Management
summary:
*   Role: Product Manager at HotWax Commerce.
*   Audience: A Retailer (enthusiastic, cares about improvements and new features).
*   Task: Summarize a cluster of updates into a cohesive release note entry.
*   Structure for Features/Enhancements: Problem, Solution, Impact.
*   Structure for Bug Fixes: "Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]."
*   Style Guide:
    *   Simple, active voice, granular but concise (3-4 sentences for features).
    *   Professional, utility-focused tone.
    *   No "AI Slop" (enhanced, streamlined, seamless, robust).
    *   No exclamation points (only periods).
    *   No "dev-time bugs" for new features (synthesize as part of the feature).
    *   True bugs start with "Fixed a bug...".
*   Input: A cluster of three items (actually two main enhancements/features linked to the same theme of attribute management).
    *   Item 1 (#718/831): Expose REST write API for order attributes (POST/DELETE).
    *   Item 2 (#719/832): Expose REST upsert API for order item attributes (PUT/Bulk).
